bagPolicy.summary: Bags are allowed, and all bags are subject to search at entry. Contact the box office with other bag questions.
bagPolicy.quote: Bags are allowed into the venue. All bags are subject to search upon entry.

parking.summary: Several garages are next to the venue or within a few blocks. Lockwood Garage, Harbor Park Garage and Frederick Street Garage all offer validated parking, through the Parkway App, a QR code at the door, or a sticker from door staff.
parking.quote: there are many great parking options adjacent to the venue or available within just a few blocks

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Baltimore Soundstage. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: A kitchen and 3 full bars serve food, drinks, water, soda and juice. Outside food and drink aren't allowed. Prescription medication must be in its original container with ID matching the prescription.
allowed: Prescription medication in its original container
concessions.quote: We do not allow any outside food or drink into the venue.

accessibility.summary: The venue and its general admission areas are wheelchair accessible, and ADA seating is first come, first served. Contact the box office in advance at BoxOffice@BaltimoreSoundstage.com or 410-244-0057. Trained service animals are welcome, but emotional support animals are not admitted.
accessibility.quote: The venue and it's general admission areas are all wheelchair accessible.

reEntry.summary: Baltimore Soundstage has a no re-entry policy. Once your ticket is scanned, you can't leave and come back, though an outdoor smoking area may be available.
reEntry.quote: Unfortunately no, our venue has a no re-entry policy.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open Tuesday 11am to 3pm and Wednesday through Friday 12pm to 6pm, and during all shows, when it doubles as will call and guest list check-in with ID ready. Mobile tickets scan from your phone with brightness turned up. Shows are all ages unless listed 18+ or 21+, which require a valid physical government photo ID, and Maryland residents need a horizontal ID to buy alcohol.
ticketPickup.quote: Our box office doubles as Will Call & Guest List check-in during shows.

gates.summary: Door times on your ticket are not set times. Plan to arrive when doors open to catch the full lineup.
gates.quote: Door times listed on your ticket are not set times.
